Some English words are also slightly distorted or illegible. This is a common AI artifact where text looks real from a distance but fails character-level scrutiny.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The perspective of the menu fold is generally consistent, but the background ceiling line and light fixture seem slightly warped or inconsistently aligned with the menu's vanishing point. The top edge of the leftmost panel curves unnaturally.
The paper texture is very uniform and lacks the subtle micro-variations, creases, or wear one might expect on a used physical menu. It has a slightly 'plastic' or overly smooth digital appearance.
